article.title: How Specializing the Vocabulary of SLMs Can Cut Inference Cost by 77% in Real Applications

harvestedTerms.summary: A Hugging Face blog post from Dharma-AI describes VocabX, a vocabulary specialization method for small language models (SLMs) that reportedly cuts inference cost by 77% in a production essay-grading system. The piece is technically focused: it explains why generated tokens cost more than input tokens (the prefill vs. decode distinction), how general-purpose tokenizers create two kinds of waste (fragmentation and excess vocabulary entries), and how VocabX addresses both by optimizing vocabulary selection around token cost rather than frequency. The case study is a Portuguese essay grader built on Qwen3-4B.

article.title: The Hidden Upside of Tech Challenges

harvestedTerms.summary: MIT Sloan Management Review piece presenting research on 'technostress,' distinguishing technology-as-hindrance from technology-as-challenge, and arguing managers can reframe worker perceptions of digital tools to improve motivation and engagement. The article is grounded in workplace psychology and information systems research, with AI and generative AI mentioned only as examples of stress-inducing tools. It has minimal AI-specific conceptual content.

article.title: Panache — RTS Belle Époque pour mobile

harvestedTerms.summary: Simon Willison links to Panache, a French steampunk fork of his Battle Drones vibe-coded RTS game. The fork reskins the mobile/browser game to Belle Époque France with new models and animated intro. Minimal AI terminology content — this is essentially a game release/fork announcement with a creative open-source story.

article.title: Anthropic takes on Muse with Claude Duet, its new AI agent

harvestedTerms.summary: Anthropic announces Claude Duet, a new AI agent for professionals and small business owners, launching as a research preview on iOS, Android, and web. Built on Claude Opus 5.5, it offers morning briefings, proactive monitoring, task execution via a virtual machine, and human-in-the-loop approvals for sensitive actions. The article is primarily a product launch announcement.
